messages:
Ana (PM): Quick check — Polaris Compute sent the final collateral bundle for the joint solution brief. Need a rapid sanity pass: logo lockups, alt text, approved quote wording, and hero art. Link: https://files.redwood.example/polaris-final.zip
Ravi (Design): I'll audit assets now. quick Q: do we have a preferred horizontal vs square lockup?
Marina (Partner Ops): Polaris requests horizontal on the one-pager, square for social tiles. They included a brand-guidelines.pdf with explicit spacing rules.
Ravi (Design): Noted. Found a color mismatch in their PPT — use brand primary #0B4F8C from their guide. Also horizontal needs ~8px extra left clearspace on our layout to meet their specs.
Jeff (Marketing): For the hero, I sketched a mock that combines their dashboard and our inference callout. If design signs off I'll request hi-res from Polaris.
Ravi (Design): Export requirements: 1920x640 PNG for hero, transparent overlay for copy + responsive JPGs. Alt text proposal: "Polaris Compute dashboard showing Redwood inference pipeline and latency graph" — Sam, approve?
Sam (Legal): Alt text is fine. On quotes: Polaris shared a draft: "Redwood + Polaris reduced inference latency by 3x in our benchmark workloads." They now want to soften public copy unless we append methodology.
Ana (PM): I prefer keeping the specific stat with an appendix describing methodology, but if the appendix is delayed use softer language. Marketplace listing needs to go live by tomorrow morning.
Marina (Partner Ops): Polaris can approve the appendix by next Tue, not today. They asked if we can publish a teaser with softer copy and swap later.
Ravi (Design): I'll prepare two art variants (teaser + full-stat) so swapping later is trivial.
Sam (Legal): Also flagged trademark usage: include TM on first mention only, and do not alter or crop their wordmark. Design ensure no cropping of polygon mark.
Ravi (Design): Will export lockups as SVG + PNG, include min-clear guidance and ensure polygon is intact.
asset-bot: Upload complete: polaris-final.zip (4.1MB) — https://files.redwood.example/polaris-final.zip
Jeff (Marketing): Marketplace teaser copy idea: "Redwood + Polaris: simplified, low-latency inference for compute-heavy applications." CTA: "See benchmark & tech brief". Thoughts?
Ana (PM): Good. Add CTA link placeholder to appendix. Avoid numeric claims on the tile until appendix is live.
Sam (Legal): Confirmed — avoid "Guaranteed" or numeric claims without methodology appendix. Standard marketplace T&Cs apply.
Marina (Partner Ops): Action list: (1) Jeff to secure teaser quote OK from Polaris (today), (2) Ravi to export both hero variants and lockups, (3) Ana to draft appendix skeleton, (4) Sam to prepare microcopy guidance for marketplace, (5) I'll coordinate final sign-off and schedule publish.
Ravi (Design): Uploading hero variants now with PNG, JPG, SVG lockups.
asset-bot: Upload complete: polaris-hero-variants.zip (11.8MB) — https://files.redwood.example/polaris-hero-variants.zip
Jeff (Marketing): Polaris replies: teaser wording OK, appendix due next Tue. They prefer we publish the teaser tomorrow AM.
Ana (PM): Great. Final pre-publish checklist: confirm alt text is present, TM usage in copy, final art exports uploaded, and that the publish slot is scheduled. Please react with :thumbsup: when done.
Ravi (Design): :thumbsup:
Jeff (Marketing): :thumbsup:
Sam (Legal): :thumbsup:
Marina (Partner Ops): :thumbsup:
Ana (PM): Thanks team — moving this to the publish queue.
